_no_statistics: Deliberately contains ZERO market statistics -- no median price, no days-on-market, no appreciation, no inventory. The Boerne numbers are being pulled from connectMLS by another agent and were not available when this was built. A place-and-feel piece works without them; an invented median price is a licensed agent publishing a false market claim. If numbers arrive later they belong in a SEPARATE video, not retrofitted into this script.
_claims_check: Every concrete noun in this script is something I confirmed by looking at the footage or at Media/b-roll/boerne/LIBRARY.md, not from general knowledge of Boerne.
'a bandstand on the plaza' -- boerne-main-plaza-gazebo-*: 'The Main Plaza bandstand/gazebo with its clock cupola'.
'ducks in the pond' -- boerne-plaza-duck-pond-*: 'Main Plaza duck pond, white ducks on the limestone rim'.
'the creek runs right through it' -- boerne-cibolo-creek-* and boerne-downtown-* show Cibolo Creek and the downtown block in the same set.
NOT CLAIMED: that Heath lives in Boerne. He practises at KW Boerne / KW City View and is San Antonio-based (CLAUDE.md §23), so the CTA says 'I sell the Hill Country', never 'I live here'.
NOT CLAIMED: drive time to San Antonio as a specific number -- phrased as commutable rather than '30 minutes', which I did not measure.
_music_gain_why: Tuned by measurement, not by ear-guess. The bed is loudnorm'd to -26 LUFS and the voice to -18, so the nominal separation is (26 + |gain| - 18) dB before the sidechain adds anything. At -7 this track measured a median 13.5 dB under the voice -- short of the 18-19 dB standard, because this bed is denser than the TREC series' piano and the sidechain was contributing little. -11 puts nominal at 19 dB.
_music_why: Highest measured drive of the 12 tracks (0.161 via measure_music_tempo.py) and 132s long, so no loop seam under a 30s cut. Cinematic bed suits drone. Licence-clean (Pixabay Content License).

beats.text: Everybody asks me what Boerne is actually like.
Close enough to San Antonio to commute. Far enough that it doesn't feel like it.
There's a bandstand on the plaza. Ducks in the pond. The creek runs right through it.
Nobody moves to the Hill Country for a number. They drive through once, and they can't stop thinking about it.
I'm Heath Shepard. I sell the Hill Country. Follow along.

_shot_rhythm: This one is pure showcase -- the footage IS the content, so the cut list is the best 15 shots in the library, ordered hero -> town -> landmark -> detail -> hero. 1.7-2.1s cuts. Static subjects (ducks close-up, flags, storefront) get a push; everything shot from the drone already moves.
